limits: Commands document observed runs, not a hardened replay entrypoint; original temporary archive paths may no longer exist.
The container timeout does not by itself verify cleanup after interruption.
Archive hashes were checked before earlier probes; paths were not made immutable for these callback runs.
Owner and token are caller-supplied, guessable values and do not isolate untrusted native code.
The experiment uses a test registry, not the product request lifecycle; GC coverage is one explicit collection, not stress testing.
Concurrent release is a smoke test and does not force a callback to be in progress when release begins.
Native-created threads, reentrancy, cancellation, PHP exceptions and complete ABI compatibility were not verified.
